thread:
laura_sales: Quick handoff needed for health-POC netops. Requirements: preserve client IP for audit, allow TLS-inspect boxes, clarify SNI rewrite impact on mTLS/pinning, and exact egress IPs/FQDNs they can allowlist. Also want a 2-line cost note for a 2-week test.

andy_netops: Short summary: peering preserves source IP natively; PrivateLink is faster to stand up but usually NATs to endpoint EIP (unless you run a proxy/NLB). PrivateLink has small hourly endpoint + per-GB processing fees.

jun_infra: POC patterns (pick one):
- PrivateLink + NLB + reverse-proxy in customer VPC -> preserves client identity via X-Forwarded-For, fastest onboarding.
- Cross-account VPC Peering -> native src-IP preserved, best for IP-based ACLs/audit.

security_ops: If they do TLS inspection that terminates or rewrites SNI, cert pinning/mTLS can break. Mitigations: terminate mTLS at their edge and use app auth to us, or request Dedicated (mutual TLS support). Proxy-protocol v2 is available only on Dedicated/Private deployments.

maya_sales_eng: Can we get a copy/paste allowlist snippet?

andy_netops: Copy/paste (replace placeholders):
```
# OUTBOUND allowlist for Redwood POC
# replace <REDFW_ENDPOINT_EIP_1> with EIP(s) we provide
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to <REDFW_ENDPOINT_EIP_1> 443
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to <REDFW_ENDPOINT_EIP_2> 443
allow udp from 10.0.0.0/16 to <REDFW_ENDPOINT_EIP_1> 123  # NTP if required
# If using PrivateLink, ensure subnet route to the interface ENI is reachable
```

jun_infra: Short client-IP bullets to include in email:
- VPC Peering: preserves client src IP end-to-end.
- PrivateLink + reverse-proxy: preserves client via X-Forwarded-For header.
- Dedicated: supports proxy-protocol v2 to pass TCP src (requires reservation).

maya_sales_eng: 2-line cost note for finance?

andy_netops: Cost note: "PrivateLink: small hourly endpoint fee + per-GB processing (~$0.02-0.05/hr + $0.01-0.05/GB). Peering: no endpoint-hour fee but possible AZ/region transfer costs; for ~100GB over 2 weeks expect O($10-100) in data fees depending on topology. Dedicated requires capacity commit (monthly)."

deploy-bot: Runbook published: privatelink-onboarding v2 -> https://redwood.example.com/internal/runbooks/privatelink-onboarding :white_check_mark:

laura_sales: Perfect. I'll send this to their NetOps with the snippet and ask for the SOC questionnaire items. Will follow up if they want a Dedicated pilot. Thanks all :raised_hands:
